svg.title: What the execution context contains for an Update of a Cedar work order
svg.desc: The plug-in asks the service provider for IPluginExecutionContext. The context has six groups of data. Who: UserId, InitiatingUserId, BusinessUnitId, OrganizationId. What and where: MessageName Update, PrimaryEntityName cedar_workorder, PrimaryEntityId, Stage, Mode, Depth, IsInTransaction, CorrelationId. InputParameters: the request, with Target holding only the submitted columns; writable in PreValidation and PreOperation. OutputParameters: the response, filled only in PostOperation. SharedVariables: small serializable values passed to later steps, including the tag sent by an API caller. Entity images: PreEntityImages and PostEntityImages, snapshots registered on the step and read by alias. ParentContext links to the operation that triggered this one.
svg.text: The execution context: everything the platform tells your plug-in about one step execution
context for: Update cedar_workorder WO-1002, PostOperation, synchronous
All properties are read-only; three collections have contents you can change.
